CustomField.description: Enter the date associated with the status of this product. This will help with reporting where in the old instance we use "date first contract signed" - now we can use the product status date.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Update the status date every time you change the Account Status. The date is auto copied to Opp and Account, be sure it's accurate when changing status to Active.
CustomField.label: Product Status Date
